answer_1.quote: Data-to-text tasks aim to generate meaningful and coherent natural language text that faithfully conveys structured data. ... AMR-to-text generation where the goal is to generate a fluent and grammatical sentence that is faithful to a given AMR graph.
answer_1.outputs: Natural language sentences generated from AMR graphs

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the results with BLEU and chrF++ metrics. We also report the meaning (M) component of the MF-score , which measures how well the source AMR graph can be reconstructed from the generated sentence. We use BERTScore allowing a semantic evaluation that depends less on the surface forms.

answer_4.quote: To further assess the quality of the generated texts by the adapter-based models in LDC2020T02, we conduct a human evaluation via crowdsourcing using Amazon Mechanical Turk. ... evaluate the meaning similarity, i.e., how close in meaning is the generated text to the reference sentence.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate on a 1-7 Likert scale for meaning similarity
